column1: # Manual rating overrides for notable players absent from the EA FC26 CSV.
# Ratings are hand-estimated FIFA-style OVRs, applied on top of (and winning
# over) CSV matches. Add/adjust freely before re-running `go run ./cmd/import`.

#     recent prior-edition rating where the FC26 number didn't surface. ---
# --- Recovered via club cross-reference: present in CSV under a spelling/
#     romanization variant, found by club + name-similarity. Exact EA ratings. ---
